description: hand-authored structured rubric (behavioral anchors + solve-first), blind to eval diagnosis

edits.label: Yes
edits.text: The reply gives correct, on-point help the student can act on — a hint, an explanation, a worked step, an example, or a focused question aimed at the specific error or next step.

edits.label: To some extent
edits.text: The reply makes a real attempt to guide but it is incomplete, generic, or only partly on target, so it under-specifies what the student should do next.

edits.label: No
edits.text: The reply provides no usable guidance — it only greets, praises, restates the problem, hands over the bare answer, or is irrelevant to the student's need.
First work out for yourself what correct guidance here would be, then judge the reply against that substance rather than its politeness, fluency, or length.
